en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's look at an insect field guide

Gonta not like complicated books...
Make Gonta sleepy...

But Gonta know...
Gonta no can make same excuses...

Shuichi, this book have bug pictures from
all over world!
Bugs more pretty in real life, though...

We get outta here, Gonta show Shuichi
all the pretty bugs!

Did you know? Gentlemen hide weapons
in shoes and canes! Gonta not know that!

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah...maybe I shouldn't have
let him read that...

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
